risks.detail: The exact v1 open returns VersionError; no rollback mechanism has been supplied.

limitations: Disposable Chromium/Linux only; archived +14 is real static code but all origin, storage and actions are synthetic.
Service-worker enumeration and database upgrades are not one atomic operation; bfcache, crash, slow writes, late opens, multiple origins and partitions remain unproven.
Version bump was performed only on the disposable fixture database; it breaks unadapted legacy/offline rollback.
The candidate +41 app, real backup, live auth/sync, physical Android and Safari/iOS were not tested.
Network was restricted to loopback at the page and DNS levels; no production action was intended.
